fundamentals.pe_assessment: Frozen October 6 snapshot: trailing P/E 29.35 x, forward P/E 16.57 x (vendor estimate), dividend yield 2.00% (vendor reported). Inference: backlog supports growth, but 29.35 x trailing earnings/16.57 x estimated forward earnings price meaningful execution improvement.
fundamentals.margin_analysis: FY26 net profit RM1.052 bn +5%; construction net profit RM741.6 m +19% with 5.0% segment net margin; property profit RM310.7 m -18%. Group net margin 5.7% vs 6.1%, on issuer presentation revenue includingJV share; do not equate it with statutory consolidated margin.
fundamentals.debt_analysis: Total borrowings RM14.125 bn, cash/marketable securities RM4.712 bn, net debt RM9.414 bn; net gearing 72% vs 53%, current ratio 1.5 x vs 1.9 x. CFO improved to RM807.6 m from-RM78.5 m, but investing outflow RM3.401 bn and financing inflow RM3.389 bn show expansion funding dependence.
fundamentals.growth_outlook: RM61.2 bn unbilled orderbook and construction profit growth support future execution. Management expects gearing<70% by late FY27 and property recovery; these are targets, not delivered cash or earnings.
key_risks: Net gearing increased 19percentage points; short-term borrowings RM6.341 bn vs RM2.906 bn.
Property profit decline and execution/collection timing;29.35 x trailing P/E requires stronger growth than FY26 achieved.
key_strengths: Construction profit rose 19% with stable segment margins.
Large verified orderbook and positive CFO after previous negative year.
fundamentals.summary: Gamuda has credible construction growth and backlog, but the frozen valuation and increased 72% gearing make near-term returns highly dependent on execution and cash collection. Neutral/medium reflects these substantive offsets rather than a missing perfect valuation model.
